product_overview: Abha Pharmacy Management System is a dual-portal web application for customers and pharmacy staff. Customers can search medicines, upload prescriptions, manage profiles, and place orders, while staff can manage inventory, verify prescriptions, process sales, handle alerts, and review reports.
core_goals: Let customers search medicines and view availability and pricing before visiting the store.
Let customers upload prescriptions and submit pickup or delivery requests online.
Let staff manage medicines, batches, suppliers, and stock from a central operational portal.
Let staff process walk-in sales, verify prescriptions, and fulfill online orders.
Let staff monitor low-stock and near-expiry alerts and resolve them with traceable actions.
Let the business review revenue and sales activity from recorded transactions.

features.name: Customer Authentication
features.description: Customers can access their account through a dedicated login flow and reach their dashboard after successful sign-in.
user_flows: Navigate to /login/customer -> Fill in email address -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the customer dashboard

features.name: Medicine Discovery & Search
features.description: Customers can browse the catalog, search for medicines, filter by category, sort results, and open a medicine’s detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/catalog -> Type a medicine name into search -> Apply a category filter -> Change the sort order -> Review the matching medicine results -> Open a medicine detail view
Navigate to /customer/catalog -> Enter a search term with no matches -> Review the empty results message -> Clear or revise the search -> See a new set of matching medicines

features.name: Clinical Monograph & Direct OTC Ordering
features.description: Customers can review a specific medicine’s details, adjust quantity, and place an order for an eligible formulation.
user_flows: Navigate to a medicine detail view -> Review the clinical information and price -> Adjust the quantity within the allowed range -> Observe the total price update -> Submit the formulation order
Navigate to a medicine detail view -> Increase quantity beyond the allowed range -> Review the validation feedback -> Reduce quantity to an allowed value -> Submit the formulation order

features.name: Digital Cart & Multi-Item Checkout
features.description: Authenticated customers can review cart items, choose fulfillment mode, select payment method, and place a pharmacy order.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/cart -> Review selected medicines and quantities -> Adjust item quantities -> Choose doorstep delivery or pharmacy pickup -> Select a payment method -> Place the order
Navigate to /customer/cart -> Adjust item quantities -> Switch fulfillment mode -> Review the updated order summary -> Place the order

features.name: Prescription Upload
features.description: Customers can upload a prescription file with instructions for pharmacist review.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/prescription/upload -> Choose a prescription image or PDF file -> Enter doctor or dosage instructions -> Submit the prescription -> See a submission confirmation
Navigate to /customer/prescription/upload -> Choose a file in an unsupported format -> Review the validation feedback -> Select a supported file type -> Submit the prescription

features.name: Patient Profile & Address Management
features.description: Customers can review and update their contact and delivery profile details.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/profile -> Open profile editing -> Update street, city, pincode, and phone number -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile details

features.name: Staff Authentication
features.description: Staff and owners use a separate login flow to reach the operational dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login/admin -> Fill in staff email address -> Fill in staff password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the staff dashboard

features.name: Staff Point of Sale (POS)
features.description: Staff can process in-store walk-in sales, choose medicines and batches, enter quantities, and complete checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/pos -> Select medicines and batches -> Enter sale quantities -> Review the line items and totals -> Complete the checkout -> See the receipt summary

Navigate to /admin/pos -> Select a batch with insufficient stock -> Enter a quantity that exceeds availability -> Review the validation feedback -> Reduce the quantity to a valid amount -> Complete the checkout

features.name: Prescription Verification Queue
features.description: Staff can review uploaded prescriptions and approve or reject them with remarks.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/prescriptions -> Open a pending prescription -> Review the uploaded document and details -> Approve or reject the prescription -> Add remarks -> See the updated verification status

features.name: Statutory Schedule H Register
features.description: Staff can inspect Schedule H and H1 ledger entries by drug category and search for patient, doctor, or batch details.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/schedule_h -> Filter records by Schedule H or H1 classification -> Search by patient name, prescribing doctor, or batch number -> Review the matching ledger entries

features.name: Supplier Directory & Procurement Master
features.description: Staff can search supplier records and add new supplier profiles for procurement traceability.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/suppliers -> Search by company name or GSTIN -> Review matching suppliers -> Open supplier creation -> Enter supplier contact and address details -> Submit the supplier form -> See the new supplier record
Navigate to /admin/suppliers -> Open supplier creation -> Enter incomplete supplier details -> Review the validation feedback -> Complete the missing details -> Submit the supplier form

features.name: Revenue & Sales Analytics Console
features.description: Staff can review revenue summaries and transaction audit rows for operational oversight.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/reports -> Review the KPI summary cards -> Inspect recent transaction rows -> Compare the displayed sales metrics for the selected period

features.name: Staff Management & RBAC
features.description: Owner-level staff administration supports onboarding, role assignment, and deactivation of accounts.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/staff -> Fill in new staff member details -> Submit the staff form -> See the new staff account in the list
Navigate to /admin/staff -> Select an active staff account -> Deactivate the account -> See the account marked as inactive

Real-time low-stock, cold-chain, and expiry alerts

Staff access control, pharmacist onboarding, and role-based permissions (Owner only)
